deficiencies.description: The text states 'during adolescence and maturation', but the rewrite replaces 'adolescence' with 'differentiation'.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: because obviously during adolescence and maturation, this occurs from infancy to adulthood.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: because differentiation and maturation also occur from infancy to adulthood.

considerations.sourcePassage: Here at this stage here, most of your growth, really, most of your lineage specification and your expansive growth has happened during embryogenesis, during the time that you were born.
considerations.reason: The phrase 'during the time that you were born' is a spoken slip or clarification of the pre-birth period (embryogenesis), so omitting it in favor of 'during embryogenesis' is treated as an allowed removal of spoken repetition/filler.
